meta.name: Editorial Blue Field
meta.description: Sparse saturated-blue plane punctuated by full-bleed classical painting, joined by a scroll-scrubbed camera move. Technical drafting furniture (hairlines, tick marks, mono chips) against a serif editorial voice.
meta.source_references: Screen recordings of a reference site, sampled at 8fps and read as contact sheets. Design language only — no copy, imagery or branding taken.

primary.role: the field; most of the page is this single plane

secondary.role: warm ivory of the painted imagery, and paper-toned sections

accent.role: near-black chips and buttons; used sparingly, small

neutral.usage: white for type on the field; mid blues only for hairlines and inactive marks

color.contrast_strategy: White on saturated blue at full strength; no mid-tone text. Imagery carries all the warmth, so the UI itself stays two colours.

font_families.heading: transitional serif — old-style figures, moderate contrast
font_families.mono: grotesque mono for labels, coordinates and tick annotations

typography.font_style_notes: The serif is the voice; it is never set large enough to shout. Every label is uppercase mono at ~10px with wide tracking. Body copy stays under 1rem — the restraint is the point, and it is what makes the imagery read as the loud element.

spacing.content_density: very low — a viewport typically carries one label, one heading and one paragraph
spacing.section_rhythm: one full viewport per beat; copy occupies roughly a third of it

layout.grid_system: 12-column with visible hairline rules at fixed percentages, not at column edges
layout.columns: content sits in a single narrow column, offset to one side rather than centred
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric; text held to one third of the width with the rest left empty or given to imagery

shape.border_usage: 1px hairlines at low opacity, used as structure rather than containment
shape.divider_style: full-height vertical rules with repeating tick marks, like a drafting scale

elevation.depth_cues: depth comes from the imagery and camera movement, never from shadow

iconography.style: minimal line marks — crosshairs, plus signs, tick rules
iconography.preferred_set: custom drafting marks rather than a UI icon set

motion.entrance_pattern: blur and rise, staggered by line
motion.exit_pattern: blur and lift, scrubbed by scroll rather than timed
motion.philosophy: Motion belongs to the camera, not to the elements. The page does not animate at you; you move through it, and it responds at exactly your pace.

components.button_style: small pill or square, near-black on the field, uppercase mono label with a trailing mark
components.card_style: translucent panel over the field, hairline border, no radius, no shadow
components.navigation_pattern: fixed minimal bar, wordmark left, two or three mono links right, one filled action
components.modal_style: full-bleed takeover rather than a floating dialog
components.list_style: hairline-separated rows with a mono index number
components.component_notes: Components are deliberately plain so they never compete with the imagery.

aesthetic.era_influence: 19th-century academic painting held inside a contemporary technical grid

visual_language.complexity: very low in the UI, very high in the imagery
visual_language.whitespace_usage: dominant — empty blue is the most common element on the page
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: imagery carries nearly all of it; type is a whisper alongside
visual_language.focal_strategy: one subject per viewport, entered and left by camera movement
visual_language.contrast_level: extreme between UI and imagery, minimal within each
visual_language.texture_usage: canvas weave and brushwork in the imagery; the UI plane is perfectly flat

composition.hierarchy_method: position and emptiness rather than size
composition.flow_direction: vertical, continuous, with no perceptible section boundaries
composition.grouping_strategy: label, heading and body as one tight block, isolated in space
composition.negative_space_role: structural — it is what makes a small serif line feel important

imagery.photo_treatment: hyperreal oil painting, warm ivory and gold against blue
imagery.illustration_style: classical figurative — robed figures, hands, branches, fruit
imagery.graphic_elements: hairline rules, tick scales, crosshairs, small coordinate readouts
imagery.image_shape: full-bleed, edge to edge, never framed or rounded

interaction_feel.feedback_style: understated — opacity and position, no colour flashes
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: slight lift or fade; nothing scales
interaction_feel.transition_personality: cinematic; scenes are joined by travel, never by a wipe or a mask
interaction_feel.loading_style: content resolves in place rather than showing a spinner

overview.effect_intensity: high but invisible — the work goes into hiding the seams
overview.performance_tier: medium; one canvas and a streamed image set
overview.fallback_strategy: static first frame, then progressive upgrade; page fully readable with no canvas at all
overview.primary_technology: scroll-scrubbed frame sequence on canvas, with WebGL for the still scenes

background_effects.description: A single saturated blue plane. No gradient, no noise, no animation.

particle_systems.description: No particles observed. Atmosphere comes from the painted imagery instead.

3d_elements.description: Depth is pre-rendered into the frames rather than computed. No live 3D observed.

shader_effects.description: No shader distortion visible; all apparent motion is frame-to-frame.

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: each beat enters around 80% viewport and leaves from 45%
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: line-staggered blur and rise on entry; blur and lift on exit
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: entry is timed, exit is scrubbed

scroll_morphing.description: The defining effect. Scroll position selects a frame in a pre-rendered sequence, so the subject itself acts — a figure draws a cloth across the frame, and the camera pulls back out of the resulting field to find a hand binding a graft. Scenes are joined at moments when one large soft form fills the frame, so no cut is perceptible.

text_effects.description: Headings split into lines and rise out of blur, staggered.

cursor_effects.description: Standard cursor. A live coordinate readout is shown in a corner instead.
